lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Sequential vertical columns of high-intensity circular pixel clusters (blobs) located posterior to the pectoral fin insertion, maintaining a roughly equidistant spatial arrangement across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Elevated luminance values forming vertical linear bands that intersect the centroids of the primary circular blobs, resulting in a series of grid-aligned anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal linear features running across the upper third of the visible flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient from high luminance on the dorsal edge to low luminance (shadow) on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Presence of approximately 6-8 discrete high-luminance circular spots distributed within the boundary of the visible dorsal fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: A distinct gradient transition in spot diameter and density, where the cephalic region exhibits a high frequency of micro-blobs that transition into larger, grid-aligned spots posterior to the gill slits.
